guide.title: Guide
guide.setup_settlement: Step {{step}} of {{total}}: walk your settler to a free corner (no settlement on a neighbouring corner) and build a settlement there.
guide.setup_road: Step {{step}} of {{total}}: build a road on an edge next to your new settlement.
guide.building: Building your {{kind}}… your settler must stay until it is finished.
guide.wait_clock: Setup done! The dice clock starts with the first settlement; soon your settlements will collect resources.
guide.keys: Keys: WASD or arrows walk, right-click a spot to build, R road, E settlement, C city.
guide.touch: Tap a spot on the map to walk there or build. Drag to move the map, pinch to zoom.

tips.produce: Every few seconds the dice roll. Each hex whose number comes up gives a resource to every settlement next to it (2 for a city).
tips.roads: Build roads from your network to reach new corners; new settlements must touch one of your roads.
tips.settle: A settlement costs {{settlement}} and is worth 1 point. Spots on 6 and 8 produce most often.
tips.city: Upgrade a settlement to a city ({{city}}): it produces double and is worth 2 points.
tips.trade: Too much of one resource? Trade {{ratio}} of the same kind with the bank for any other, or better at a harbor. Or post an offer on the trade board for other players.
tips.robber: On a 7 nothing is produced and the robber takes half the resources of everyone holding more than {{limit}}. Spend before the 7!
tips.cards: Developments ({{card}}) give knights, free roads, resources or hidden points.
tips.goal: The first player to reach {{target}} points wins. The longest road and the largest army give extra points.

help.title: How to play
help.goal: Goal: be the first to reach {{target}} points. Settlements are worth 1, cities 2.
help.dice: There are no turns. Every {{seconds}} seconds the clock rolls two dice for everyone; hexes with that number give resources to the settlements and cities around them.
help.setup: At the start your settler walks the island and builds your first 2 settlements and 2 roads for free. Players still doing this are never robbed.
help.build: Costs: road {{road}} · settlement {{settlement}} · city {{city}}. Buildings take a few seconds to finish.
help.robber: On a 7 nothing is produced, the robber takes half the resources of anyone holding more than {{limit}}, and then it moves to a neighbouring hex, which produces nothing while it stays there.
help.trade: Trade with the bank at {{ratio}}:1, or 3:1 and 2:1 at harbors where you have a settlement. Players trade on the board: post an offer and anyone can take it.
help.cards: Developments cost {{card}}: knights move the robber and steal, others give roads, resources or points.
help.keys: WASD or arrows walk · right-click: walk or build · R road · E settlement · C city · T trade · Shift+WASD camera.
help.touch: Tap the map to walk or build · drag to move the map · pinch to zoom · buttons below build and trade.

v.ages: Ages: advance on your own to the Age of the Sea ({{age2}}) and the Golden Age ({{age3}}) for points, faster builds and more. The age button is under the build buttons.
v.settlers: Settlers stay all game: every building needs one of your settlers on the spot. Buy more with the Settler button; at rest they gather on their number.
v.population: Largest population: {{population}} points for the biggest population, like the longest road.
v.fog: Hidden island: a light line surrounds what you see now; land you saw before stays under a light veil.
v.numbers: Hidden numbers: you see only the numbers you discover yourself, next to your buildings or under your settlers.
